fit: Original known train labels plus known source-train diagnostic labels; one query/object group; exclude original dev/test groups and hashes.
head: unchanged LogisticRegression C=10 balanced; frozen normalized image embeddings
support_gate: maximum cosine similarity to training positives >= minimum leave-one-object-out positive neighbor similarity minus 0.05; computed only from train images, frozen before scoring followup
calibration: same original dev-only empirical threshold rule applied to gated scores
test_status: adaptive diagnostic: original test has been inspected; not fresh independent evaluation
